title: AMP CMD data deposition review
bodyHtml:
The TwinsUK adipose fatty acid GWAS summary statistics submitted to the CMDKP by Kerrin Small's group may be downloaded here.

Twins UK QTL data submitted to the CMDKP by Kerrin Small's group:

Adipose cis-eQTLs

  • README file
  • Data description file
  • Download cis eQTL data file (2 GB)

Adipose cis-meQTLs

  • README file
  • Data description file
  • Download cis meQTL data file (44 GB)

 

 

STARNET milestone 3 data (Bjorkegren, Roussos)

STARNET bulk RNA seq data for AOR (n= 547), MAM (n= 552), LIVER (n= 546), SKLM (n= 550), SF (n= 573), VAF(n= 531) and whole blood (n= 481) isolated from CAD cases (from Science 2016; Table 1 in proposal; Aim 1a):

  • Processed data (raw counts) from each individual bulk RNA-seq experiment
  • Normalized and adjusted (age, gender and BMI) gene expression levels of each sample from each tissue
  • a linking file for linking RNAseq data to clinical data

Download data

STARNET milestone 3c data (Bjorkegren, Roussos)

Normalized gene expression association with SYNTAX score, Duke score, Waist-to-hip ratio, BMI, HbA1c, fp-TG, fP-LDL-Chol, fP-HDL-Chol, CRP, and P-Chol from each tissue.

Download data

 

STARNET milestone 4 data (Bjorkegren, Roussos)

STARNET bulk RNA seq data for matched CAD cases and healthy controls, including AOR (n= 138), LIVER (n= 151), SKLM (n= 164), SF (n= 126), VAF (n= 131) and isolated from n= 179 CAD cases; AOR (n= 109), LIVER (n= 106), SKLM (n= 130), SF (n= 110), VAF (n= 115) isolated from n= 143 controls (from Nature CVR 2022; Aim 1a):

  • Processed data (raw counts) from each individual bulk RNA-seq experiment
  • Normalized and adjusted gene expression levels of each sample from each tissue
  • Tissue-specific differentially expressed genes for CAD case/control status (FDR=10%)
  • Linking file for IDs in RNAseq data to IDs in clinical trait data

Download data
